title: Japanese Giant Beans in Miso Sauce
description: A hearty and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring giant beans in a rich miso sauce. Serve with steamed rice and your favorite stir-fried vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add miso paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add soy sauce, mirin, and sugar. Bring to a simmer.
Add giant beans and cook for 5 minutes, or until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.
